Ivy Park: quick heads-up from today's bring-up for sparrow-mini-ptq: structured funcall parse failures are 9.8% on a 450-sample smoke. most are small: trailing commas, lone backslashes, and occasional broken escape sequences.
Liam O'Connor: baseline fp32 rates?
Ivy Park: fp32 control on same prompts ~0.2%. so this looks quant-specific.
Nora Diaz: do we have repros saved? seed + config?
Ivy Park: yep: s3://redwood-canaries/sparrow-mini-ptq/repro-5444.jsonl (each line: prompt | seed | cfg).
Liam O'Connor: any raw failing snippets?
Ivy Park: examples pasted:
```
{"tool":"get_account","args":{"id":"acct_42"},}
```
(trailing comma) and `{"path":"/var/logs\\"}` appearing as `{"path":"/var/logs\"` -> unclosed string.
Nora Diaz: weird. any correlation with prefix length or mirror replica?
Ivy Park: concentrated when prefix_tokens > 200 (kvcache hits). when we disabled kvcache in a small run, failures dropped to ~2.5%.
Liam O'Connor: sounds like concat boundary tokenization under PTQ. mitigation ideas?
Ivy Park: quick canary-only rescue pipeline: 1) pre-parse sanitizer (repair trailing commas, escape backslashes), 2) soft-retry with temp=0.0, 3) record which step rescued the sample. initial micro-run: retry-only recovers ~20%, sanitizer-only ~62%, sanitizer+retry ~86%.
Nora Diaz: run A/B: (ptq kvcache ON) vs (ptq kvcache OFF) vs (ptq kvcache ON + sanitizer). add fp32 control. log token-level diffs and kernel build tag.
Liam O'Connor: add fields to canary config: seed, kernel_tag, tokenizer_version, streaming_chunk_size. Also capture the exact emitted token sequence around the boundary.
Ivy Park: drafted canary config: 
```
canary_name: sparrow-mini-5444
model: sparrow-mini-ptq
cohorts:
  - name: kvcache-on
    kvcache: true
  - name: kvcache-off
    kvcache: false
  - name: kvcache-on-sanitizer
    kvcache: true
    rescue_pipeline: ["sanitize_escape","repair_trailing_comma","retry_temp0"]
samples: 1000
strict_schema: true
record: ["token_diff","kernel_tag","seed"]
```
Liam O'Connor: good. also add a unit in funcall CI that injects boundary tokens (backslash, trailing comma, escaped null) to catch regressions pre-onboard.
Nora Diaz: timeline?
Ivy Park: launching this afternoon; expecting initial numbers in ~24h. will dump curated failures and rescue signatures into the ticket.
canary-bot: canary started: sparrow-mini-5444 | sparrow-mini-ptq | cohorts=3 | samples=1000 | strict_schema=true
Liam O'Connor: if kvcache correlates, we should pause PTQ rollout and add kernel/tokenizer fixes before promoting.
Ivy Park: agreed. will report back with recovery by step and examples. :thumbsup:
